ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel field with a high contrast ratio due to localized high-intensity (white) circular scars and large high-intensity textured clusters on the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark-grey base across the entire visible surface; high-intensity circular rings of 10-20 pixel diameters are distributed across the central and lower regions; high-intensity textured clusters (barnacles) are concentrated on the far-left and far-right distal lobe margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated angle of approximately 40-45 degrees; the notch depth is approximately 25% of the total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 5 and 30 pixels; peak density is higher on the right lobe compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edges transitioning into convex outer margins; the right lobe exhibits a more elongated, upward-tapering sweep compared to the left lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete, circular white pixel clusters (annular rings) distributed across the mid-section of both lobes, ranging from 5 to 15 pixels in radius.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical high-intensity linear streaks visible on the lower right lobe, approximately 40 pixels in length.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive macroscopic barnacle encrustations on the left and right distal tips, creating a highly irregular, high-contrast, three-dimensional textured boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense cluster of stalked barnacles protruding significantly from the leftmost distal margin of the fluke.
